snippet.title: What $100 Gets You in Vietnam
snippet.description:
How far can $100 really take you in Vietnam?

Vietnam has long been known as one of the most affordable travel destinations in the world. From delicious street food and budget-friendly accommodations to cheap transportation and vibrant city life, many travelers claim you can live comfortably here for a fraction of the cost compared to Western countries.

But in 2026, is Vietnam still as cheap as people say?

In this video, we break down exactly what $100 can buy in Vietnam — including meals, transportation, accommodation, coffee, and everyday experiences. From the busy streets of Hanoi to the buzzing markets of Ho Chi Minh City, we explore how far a small budget can really go in one of Southeast Asia’s most fascinating countries.

In this travel documentary, you’ll discover:

• The real cost of street food in Vietnam
• How much hotels and hostels cost
• Transportation prices across the city
• Daily expenses for travelers and digital nomads
• Whether Vietnam is still one of the cheapest countries to visit

Vietnam offers an incredible mix of culture, food, and adventure — all at prices that may surprise you.

localized.title: COUNTRIES THAT DON'T FEEL REAL
localized.description:
Some countries are so extraordinary that they feel more like scenes from a science fiction movie than real places on Earth.

In this documentary, we explore countries with landscapes, environments, and locations that seem almost impossible to believe. From the volcanic landscapes of Iceland and the giant red dunes of Namibia to the mountain monasteries of Bhutan, the endless steppes of Mongolia, the alien-looking island of Socotra, and the mirror-like salt flats of Salar de Uyuni.

These destinations challenge everything we think we know about travel. Some look like another planet. Others feel frozen in time. All of them leave visitors wondering whether they are still on Earth.

If you enjoy travel documentaries, geography, unusual destinations, hidden wonders, and extraordinary places around the world, this journey is for you.

While millions of Americans dream about moving abroad, very few realize there are tropical islands and unique destinations that offer a completely different lifestyle while still maintaining ties to the United States.

But this isn't just another travel video.

Some of these U.S. territories offer beautiful beaches, warm weather, slower living, and retirement-friendly communities. Others come with higher costs, limited healthcare options, geographic isolation, and challenges many people never consider until after they move.
